added_failure_derivation: Derived with reckon.crew.review.added_failures_from_gate_logs over the reviewed run's own arms: baseline_suite log logs/base-arm.log (revision bb45e47e0, 6 failed / 27 passed, EXIT=1) and after_suite log logs/head-arm.log (revision 6d75c489e, 1 failed / 32 passed, EXIT=1), each reduced against its own recorded cwd. The head arm's only failing id is one the base arm also fails, so added_failure_count is 0 and added_failure_ids is empty.

assertion_analysis.condition_to_fail: flight.validate_layer stops refusing an undeclared key when strict=True, so the pytest.raises at line 150 gets no exception.
the retired settle key is accepted under strict, so the pytest.raises gets no exception.
recovery._ordered_review_lanes returns a model of an excluded lane for a nameless review.
crew budget --check and the MCP budget view resolve different window sources or clocks for the same installed document.
backend_rate_statuses raises instead of returning the empty all-unpriced reading when the layer fails validation.

assertion_note: The diff adds no assertion; every assertion it relies on predates it. No added assertion compares a value against the same variable the test supplied, so none is self-confirming. The counter assertion at tests/test_follower_survives_a_config_change.py:255 compares the fixture's own counter with the constant that drives it and is a fixture sanity check, not a claim about production.
